basic_details.organization_name: Indian Institute of Technology Madras (IIT Madras)

qualification.details: Project Associate II: Four-year Bachelor's degree in Natural or Agricultural Sciences; or master's degree in Natural or Agricultural Sciences; or BVSc/B.Pharm; or bachelor's degree in engineering, Technology or Medicine from a recognized University or equivalent. Two years' experience in R&D in industrial or academic institutions or S&T organizations and scientific activities and services. Minimum 2.5 years of relevant R&D and hands-on experience in embedded hardware design and PCB design, PCB testing, schematic evaluation, board bring-up, prototype development and debugging. Experience with prototype development cycles. Experience with PCB designing in Allegro, OrCAD, KiCad, and Altium. Prior experience working in an R&D laboratory environment is mandatory.

salary_details.details: Rs. 42,000/- +30% HRA to scholars who are selected through a process as mentioned. Rs. 33,000+ 30% HRA for others who do not fall under (i).

selection_process: Short-listed for Test/Interview on the basis of the information provided in online applications.
how_to_apply: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the IIT Madras Project Associate II Recruitment 2026.
Applications must be submitted online on or before 02-09-2026.
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIT Madras to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Project Associate-II position at IIT Madras?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the Project Associate-II position at IIT Madras is September 2, 2026. It is advisable to apply well before the deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What are the minimum qualifications required for the Project Associate-II role?
faq.answer: The minimum qualifications include a four-year Bachelor's degree in Natural or Agricultural Sciences, or a Master's degree in Natural or Agricultural Sciences, or BVSc/B.Pharm, or a Bachelor's degree in engineering, technology, or medicine. Additionally, two years of R&D experience is mandatory.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Project Associate-II position?
faq.answer: The salary offered is Rs. 42,000/- +30% HRA for selected scholars, and Rs. 33,000/- +30% HRA for others who do not fall under the first category.

faq.question: Q4. How will candidates be selected for the Project Associate-II role?
faq.answer: Candidates will be shortlisted for a Test/Interview based on the information provided in their online applications.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification released by IIT Madras for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the nature of the job at IIT Madras?
faq.answer: The job is temporary in nature, specifically for the Project Associate-II position.

faq.question: Q7. What specific experience is required for the Project Associate-II role?
faq.answer: A minimum of 2.5 years of relevant R&D and hands-on experience in embedded hardware design and PCB design, PCB testing, schematic evaluation, board bring-up, prototype development, and debugging is required.

faq.question: Q8. Which software skills are preferred for this position?
faq.answer: Experience with PCB designing in Allegro, OrCAD, KiCad, and Altium is preferred for this role.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section provided above, under the 'Official Notification PDF' link.

faq.question: Q10. What is the location of the job?
faq.answer: The job is located at the Indian Institute of Technology Madras in Chennai, Tamil Nadu, with a pincode of 600036.
